_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/cc-sessions/environments.json (or point $CC_SESSIONS_RULES at it). Each rule maps a session to an Origin label. A rule matches when ALL of its provided conditions match; the FIRST matching rule wins, and user rules are evaluated before the built-in heuristics — so you can both add new tools and override cc-sessions' guesses. Conditions: cwdMatch (regex vs the session's working dir), slugMatch (regex vs the project-dir slug), entrypoint (exact match vs the registry entrypoint). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
